audience: sales callers who work lead lists and campaigns in myPhoner

useCases.title: Check the progress of a calling list
useCases.text: The AI reads lead counts of a list by state (new, call back, won, lost, archived) and by category, to show campaign progress.

useCases.title: Find a lead by phone number, email or text
useCases.text: The AI looks up a lead by exact field values, or searches lead data and comments, and shows its state.

useCases.title: Log a call outcome
useCases.text: The AI marks a lead as won, lost or for call back at a time you give, or archives it, with an optional comment.

useCases.title: Add or update leads in a list
useCases.text: The AI adds a lead to a list using the list's fields, or changes field values of an existing lead.

useCases.title: Assign or move leads between agents and lists
useCases.text: The AI gives the claim on a lead to a user, or moves a lead to another list.

useCases.title: Create a new calling list
useCases.text: The AI creates an empty calling list with the fields you choose, such as phone, email or date.
